Subject: Reference checks for Samuel Ortiz — quick intake and availability

Hi Samuel / Priya,

Thanks for moving this along — we're ready to schedule two short reference conversations (30 minutes each) as the final step for the Senior Product Designer role. To make the calls useful for the hiring panel, could you please: 

- Share 2–3 references who have managed you or partnered closely on product/UX work (name, role, company, best contact email and mobile).
- Indicate whether any of the refs prefer asynchronous notes instead of a live call.
- Confirm any blackout dates next week.

I've attached a short reference questionnaire to give your refs context on the topics we'll cover (collaboration, product judgment, delivery against deadlines). If you can send the contact details and a preferred time window (PST) by EOD today, we'll propose slots and loop in the refs.

Preferred approach: Rishi (hiring manager) leads the first call; Lauren (design lead) joins the second. Marissa (talent) will send calendar invites.

Attachment: reference_questionnaire_v2.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Hiring Manager, Product Design
Redwood Inference

Subject: Quick thank you and notes from reference calls for Samuel Ortiz

Marcus / Elena — thank you again for taking time to speak with us today about Samuel. Below are the high-level notes and next-step items for the hiring committee; please flag any corrections.

Marcus Hale (call at 11:00 5/6, 30 min) — highlights:
- Strong cross-functional influence; led design syncs with PMs and eng to land scope on time.
- Very good at synthesis under ambiguity; gave example of prioritizing metrics when roadmaps shifted.
- Areas to probe: ownership on implementation details and handling pushback from senior stakeholders.

Elena Park (call at 15:00 5/7, 30 min) — highlights:
- Ran tight launches; communicated clear trade-offs to exec stakeholders.
- Excellent collaborator with engineers; reliable on delivery.
- Recommended without reservation for senior IC role.

Next steps (for hiring team): Lauren to draft debrief summary and recommendation, Marissa to update the candidate record in HubSpot (65921) and Rishi will share a final scorecard by EOD Monday.

Thanks again — appreciate the candor and specifics.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Hiring Manager, Product Design
Redwood Inference
